name: fn_celsius_to_fahrenheit
description: Convert a temperature from degrees Celsius to degrees Fahrenheit.

name: fn_is_prime
description: Check whether a whole number is a prime number.

name: fn_count_words
description: Count how many words are in a piece of text.

name: fn_count_characters
description: Count how many characters are in a piece of text, optionally ignoring spaces.

name: fn_repeat_string
description: Repeat a string a given number of times, joined by a separator.

name: fn_calculate_tip
description: Calculate the tip for a restaurant bill given a tip percentage, optionally rounding up to the nearest whole amount.

name: fn_set_alarm
description: Set an alarm at a given hour and minute in 24-hour format, and choose whether it repeats daily.

name: fn_raise_to_power
description: Raise a base number to the power of an exponent.
